issue.title: Represent closed-while-queued launches as stood down

task_type_fields.proposal: Design and implement a non-failure stood-down outcome for a bead closed after launch submission. Keep Rust closed_while_queued refusal, preserve the bead and audit invariants, and map that typed refusal through runner lifecycle, stored outcome, notifications, CLI, and TUI instead of the generic red failure path. Source review at f3087c86ac: claim_bead_for_agent_launch wraps this Rust ValueError into RuntimeError and the promotion checkpoint raises before model execution. Determine cleanup/retention and user-visible status semantics before implementation; do not suppress other claim errors or reopen the bead.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The current epic intentionally implements a clear closed_while_queued error; its approved plan lists stood-down as a separate follow-up (sase-1li.3 note #3). Cross-surface lifecycle semantics require planning, hence large. Do not expand the current landing to include it.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1li.3 note #3 and explicitly deferred by the approved attach plan. A deliberately closed queued bead currently appears as a failed agent even though refusing the launch is correct.
